_comment: The ONE place the book's public URL lives. Change bookUrl, set urlConfirmed to true once the host is final, then run: bash tools/print-book.sh noori-shell (QR codes, PDFs and checks are all rebuilt). While urlConfirmed is false every print file is named -DRAFT.
_books: Every other topic book (.claude/skills/topic-book): add "<slug>": { "bookUrl": …, "urlConfirmed": true } under books once its URL is live and checked. A book with no entry gets urlPattern with <slug> filled in and urlConfirmed false, so its print files are -DRAFT. Its audio lives in audio/<slug>/ and its QR codes in input/qr/<slug>/ (tools/lib.js bookConfig).
